thread:
maria: Just rolled RBAC change to svc-account deployer in staging, noticed CI SAST started failing on ~150 PRs. Anyone else seeing this?
alex: yep saw noise. Many hits marked 'auth bypass' in generated proto files. Could be scan rule mismatch after generated code relocation. /cc @jin
jin: Checking scanner logs. There's also a bunch of KMS decrypt errors around the same time. Looks like scanner couldn't access artifact metadata to attach evidence: `kms.decrypt: AccessDenied` in pipeline logs.
```
2026-03-23T12:03:21Z scanner[sha]: ERROR kms.decrypt: AccessDenied principal=svc-ci-scanner
```
sec-bot: Alert: Keystore audit gap detected for service account svc-ci-scanner at 2026-03-23T12:00Z. Run `keystore:check`.
casey: This explains missing evidence. Did RBAC change remove scanner's keystore binding? I pushed a change to iam: removed `roles/keystore.decrypt` from the old group.
maria: I only applied mapping for deployers, not scanner. My bad. Reverting now. Rolling back binding for svc-ci-scanner and re-run GH action.
alex: Please also add temporary suppress rule in SAST for generated proto files to avoid noise while we confirm. Also need audit proof for compliance: we should capture keystore audit logs + pipeline trace.
jin: After rollback, pipeline shows `200 OK` for kms.decrypt and scanner uploaded evidence. DAST login flow still flaky: login test fails intermittently with 401 on headless chrome.
```
curl -i -X POST https://staging.example.com/_login -d '{"u":"bot","p":"***"}'
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
```
casey: DAST issue likely session cookie SameSite change from recent infra tweak. I'll revert the cookie flag for staging. For compliance: saving logs in S3://redwood-compliance/keystore/2026-03-23/; attaching to ticket.
maria: Thanks team. Next steps: (1) PR to re-add keystore role to scanner (2) SAST suppression for generated/*.pb.go for 48h (3) DAST cookie rollback in staging + monitor. I'll file an incident doc and tag legal/compliance. :thumbsup:
